guide.h: New York Truck Accident Lawyers Hold Negligent Carriers Accountable
body: Who handles New York truck accident cases, and why do they require specialized legal representation? Cohen & Cohen Personal Injury Lawyers, P.C. represents victims of truck accidents across New York City, and our New York truck accident lawyers understand that these cases are fundamentally different from standard car accident claims. Commercial trucking accidents involve multiple liable parties, including drivers, trucking companies, cargo loaders, and vehicle manufacturers, and require immediate investigation before critical evidence disappears.

Federal regulations under the FMCSA govern commercial truck drivers and carriers, including hours-of-service rules, weight limits, maintenance requirements, and driver qualification standards. Violations of these regulations often form the basis of a strong negligence claim. Trucking companies and their insurers move fast after an accident to protect their interests, you need an attorney who moves faster. Our team acts quickly to preserve black box data, driver logs, inspection records, and eyewitness accounts. If you or a family member was injured in a truck accident in New York, contact Cohen & Cohen today for a free, no-obligation case review.

guide.h: New York Slip and Fall Lawyers Pursue Justice Against Negligent Property Owners
body: What can a New York slip and fall lawyer do for someone injured on someone else’s property? Cohen & Cohen Personal Injury Lawyers, P.C. represents slip and fall victims throughout New York City, and our New York slip and fall lawyers hold negligent property owners, landlords, and businesses accountable when unsafe conditions cause serious injuries. A slip and fall case is not simply about proving you fell, it requires proving the property owner knew or should have known about the dangerous condition and failed to address it.

These cases are more legally demanding than most people realize. New York premises liability law requires establishing actual or constructive notice, and defendants will aggressively argue contributory fault to reduce your recovery. Evidence degrades fast, surveillance footage gets overwritten, incident reports disappear, and conditions get repaired before they’re documented. Our attorneys move quickly to preserve evidence, identify all liable parties, and build a case that stands up to scrutiny. Whether you slipped on an icy sidewalk, wet floor, or broken pavement, Cohen & Cohen is ready to fight for the compensation you deserve.

guide.h: New York Construction Accident Lawyers Enforce Your Rights Under Labor Law
body: What makes New York construction accident cases unique, and why do victims need specialized legal help? Cohen & Cohen Personal Injury Lawyers, P.C. represents construction workers and bystanders injured on job sites across New York City, and our New York construction accident lawyers leverage some of the strongest worker protection statutes in the country on your behalf. New York Labor Law Sections 200, 240, and 241 impose strict liability on property owners and general contractors for certain job site injuries, protections that exist nowhere else in the United States.

Labor Law § 240, known as the Scaffold Law, is particularly powerful as it holds owners and contractors absolutely liable for gravity-related injuries like falls from scaffolding, ladders, and elevated surfaces. These cases are high-value and heavily contested, and the defense bar fights them aggressively. You need attorneys who know this law inside and out. Cohen & Cohen Personal Injury Lawyers, P.C. has handled construction accident cases involving scaffold collapses, falling objects, electrocutions, and trench cave-ins. If you were injured on a New York construction site, contact us immediately, as strict deadlines apply and evidence must be preserved quickly.
